title: Settings
ocr_languages_description: Tesseract can use bundled and user-added language files. RapidOCR uses its fixed, verified Latin model.
about_description: Version of this build and the opt-in check for a newer release on GitHub.
check_response_error: GitHub did not send a usable release: {{reason}}
update_check_consent_help: When this is on, PDF Editor asks the GitHub releases page for the latest version at start, when you open this section and when you click Check now. It sends no documents and no personal data.

update_install.help: Downloads pdf-editor-setup-{{version}}.exe from GitHub, checks its SHA-256 sum and starts the setup. PDF Editor then closes. The setup asks before it changes anything, and your data stay.
update_install.ready: The setup is downloaded and checked.
update_install.started: The setup is starting. PDF Editor closes now.
update_install.disabled: Update checks are off. Turn them on first.
update_install.release_changed: The latest release changed after the check. Click Check now and try again.
update_install.no_setup: This release has no setup to download: {{reason}}
update_install.too_large: The setup is larger than allowed: {{reason}}
update_install.blocked_host: The download address is not allowed: {{reason}}
update_install.checksum_missing: SHA256SUMS.txt has no line for the setup. Nothing was started.
update_install.checksum_mismatch: The setup does not match its SHA-256 sum. It was deleted and not started.
update_install.disk_error: The setup could not be saved: {{reason}}
update_install.file_changed: The setup changed after the check. It was not started.
